root_cause.text: The work queue `np->refill_wq` is used in the cleanup path (`cancel_work_sync`) before it is initialized because `INIT_WORK` is placed after an early failure check that can invoke cleanup.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `INIT_WORK(&np->refill_wq, refill_skbs_work_handler)` to the beginning of `__netpoll_setup()`, before the `IFF_DISABLE_NETPOLL` check. The commit message explains that when that check fails, `skb_pool_flush()` calls `cancel_work_sync(&np->refill_wq)` on the uninitialized work queue, causing a kernel warning at `kernel/workqueue.c:4242`.
